narrative.coaching_note: Clean your hands at 11 seconds after touching bed rail A and call button and before touching phone and resident A. You touched bed rail A with your bare hand from 1.6 to 7.1 seconds, which moved contamination from bed rail A to your bare hand. You then touched call button from 7.6 to 11 seconds and phone from 12.4 to 20.7 seconds, which carried contamination to phone at 12.4 seconds. You touched resident A from 21.4 to 30.6 seconds, which carried contamination to resident A at 21.4 seconds and exposed resident A. Hand cleaning at 11 seconds was needed after contact with the surroundings, and hand cleaning at 21.4 seconds was needed before touching resident A. Cleaning at 11 seconds would have kept clean your bare hand, gloved hand, phone, and resident A.
narrative.audit_summary: Staged MRSA clip sourced from bed rail A. Bare hand touched bed rail A 1.6 to 7.1 seconds, call button 7.6 to 11 seconds, phone 12.4 to 20.7 seconds, and resident A 21.4 to 30.6 seconds. Transfers moved contamination from bed rail A to bare hand at 1.6 seconds, to call button at 7.6 seconds, to phone at 12.4 seconds, and to resident A at 21.4 seconds, producing one resident A exposure. Compliance was 0 of 2 overall, with Moment 1 at 0 of 1 and Moment 5 at 0 of 1; Moment 5 was missed at 11 seconds and Moment 1 was missed at 21.4 seconds. No glove use issue was recorded. Alcohol rub is effective against MRSA. Disinfect bed rail A, call button, phone, and resident A with an EPA List H registered disinfectant effective against MRSA.
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene at 11 seconds.
